notes.title: New version 1.21.0
notes.notes:
- new monster "Evil Eye"
- new location (tower floor)
- chance of successfully enchanting a relic with a ruby ​​increased to 85%
- minor bug fixes

notes.title: TotAL RPG version 1.20.0 is out
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added a new quest "Rescue the prisoners" + new location for this quest
[*] Added 8 new artifacts that enhance skills (2 items per class)
[*] Added the ability to enchant archer's quivers - now you can put gems and relics into them - just like weapons and armor
[*] Added an artifact for sorceress - Sorcerer's Orb. Reduces the rollback of abilities, plus you can insert gems and relics into it
[*] Improved gamepad support
[*] Strengthened the sorceress - now she is more survivable, and her skills are more effective
[*] Bug fixes and optimizations
[/list]
